events.help: The project to check or update bindings for.

--append-results.help: Append parsed results to an existing file

--backend.help: Backend on which benchmarks have run

--bench-type.help: Compute and append number of operations per second andoperations per dollar

--branch.help: Git branch name on which benchmark was performed

--commit-date.help: Timestamp of commit hash used in project_version

--crate.help: Crate for which benchmarks have run

--database.help: Name of the database used to store results

--hardware.help: Hardware reference used to perform benchmark

--key-gen.help: Parse only the results regarding keys generation time measurements

--name-suffix.help: Suffix to append to each of the result test names

--object-sizes.help: Parse only the results regarding keys size measurements

--project.help: The project to check or update bindings for.

check.help: Check if the binding files or the crate version need to be updated.

results.help: Location of criterion benchmark results directory.If the --key-size option is used, then the value would have to point toa CSV file.

update.help: Update the binding files and the crate version.
